work_title: South Wind, Clear Sky (from Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji)

places.name: Sumida
places.connection: Katsushika Hokusai was born in the Katsushika district, which is now part of Sumida, Tokyo.

places.name: Edo (modern-day Tokyo)
places.connection: Katsushika Hokusai created the Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji series, including South Wind, Clear Sky, while living in Edo.

places.name: Hokusai Museum
places.connection: The Hokusai Museum in Obuse is dedicated to the artist and displays many of his works.

places.name: The British Museum
places.connection: The British Museum holds a collection of Hokusai's works, including pieces from the Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji series.

places.name: Mount Fuji
places.connection: Mount Fuji is the central subject depicted in the artwork South Wind, Clear Sky.
